from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashBalance(BaseModel):
    """Extracted cash balance data from a single company's financial document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as stated in the document")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line item label for the cash amount in the document")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the cash balance as reported")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'dollars', 'millions')")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The date at which this balance is valid")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balances: list[CompanyCashBalance]
